#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
data-quality-auditor测试

import unittest
from pathlib import Path


class TestDataQualityAuditor(unittest.TestCase):
    """数据质量审计测试"""
    
    def test_skill_exists(self):
        """测试存在"""
        skill_dir = Path(__file__).parent
        self.assertTrue(skill_dir.exists())
